content: Support separated DTCs for UDS and OBD based on J1979-2 Description: SAE J1979-2 based UDS communication shall report a different 3 byte DTC number than for none J1979-2 UDS communication. Rationale: A further set of 3 Byte DTCs is required to avoid conflicts with UDS enhanced diagnostics. Use Case: Some manufacturers don’t want to fully change to SAE J1979-2 support with UDS and will only support the J1979-2 functionality on the limited UDS subset defined by J1979-2.
